gameDescriptionHtml:
A horror game set in a school, in which you will be a police officer who will have to investigate an earthquake. You will have to complete puzzles and face the paranormal events that occur. You have to be careful, the school covers a fairly dark past that you will be able to discover.

Step into the shoes of a police officer assigned to investigate an earthquake at the renowned “Santa Margarita” school at year 2003. Your mission is to uncover the truth behind the incident and reveal the school’s dark, hidden history. Throughout your investigation, you’ll encounter various paranormal events that defy explanation. Or can you unravel the mysteries? Additionally, you must complete a small list of puzzles that you must discover throughout the first floor of the school.

Game Features

  • Duration of 1.5 hours
  • Exploration
  • Realistic graphics
  • VHS style
  • Set on Halloween dates
  • Persecution
  • NORMAL level puzzles
  • Contains gory material and may be sensitive for some audiences
